title: Every number was there.

The story wasn't.

title: For today, let’s imagine we’re working with chargeback data
text:
For today, let’s imagine we’re working with chargeback data


Chargeback is a reversal of a credit or debit
transaction initiated by the cardholder’s bank
on customer’s request to return funds to the
customer.

title: Win rate fell from 52% to 33%.
text:
Win rate fell from 52% to 33%.
Retrain the disputes team?

 Dispute type                 Q2 disputes   Q2 win rate   Q3 disputes   Q3 win rate

 Fraud claims (hard to win)   200           20%           800           25%

 Item not received (easier)   800           60%           200           65%

 All disputes                 1,000         52%           1,000         33%



Better at both types. The mix flipped: four times as many fraud claims.

title: Write your main point in one sentence
text:
Write your main point in one sentence
    Does it change a decision?   Is it big enough to matter?   Is it new to this room?



INTERESTING IS NOT THE SAME AS IMPORTANT


      [What] [rose or fell] by [how much] [compared with what], driven by [rate, volume
      or mix] in [which segment].

title: Chargebacks rose 38% in Q3.
text:
Chargebacks rose 38% in Q3.
Two-thirds of the rise came from one fixable gap.
Increase in chargebacks by reason, Q2 to Q3 (count)                     SO WHAT

  Not received, >$250, unsigned                +300 (66% of the rise)   ≈ $96,000 a quarter in extra
                                                                        losses, still rising in September.
             Not received, other         +50

               Not as described          +45

           Unauthorised or fraud     +40                                NOW WHAT

                          Other    +11                                  Approve a six-week signature
         Duplicate or processing   +10                                  pilot on orders over $250.
                                                                        Decision today.
